function isJournal(value: unknown): boolean {
  if (value === null) return true
  if (
    !isRecord(value)
    || typeof value.operationId !== 'string'
    || typeof value.step !== 'string'
    || typeof value.startedAt !== 'number'
  ) return false
  if (value.operation === 'create') {
    if (value.step !== 'creating_worktree') return false
    if (value.creation === undefined) return true // Older journals never gain new deletion authority.
    const evidence = value.creation
    const identity = (item: unknown) => isRecord(item) && ['device', 'inode', 'birthtimeNs'].every(key => typeof item[key] === 'string')
    return isRecord(evidence)
      && ['root', 'commonDir', 'lockReason'].every(key => typeof evidence[key] === 'string' && evidence[key].length > 0)
      && ['rootIdentity', 'parentIdentity', 'commonIdentity'].every(key => identity(evidence[key]))
      && ['gitDir', 'quarantinePath', 'metadataFingerprint', 'indexFingerprint'].every(key => evidence[key] === undefined || typeof evidence[key] === 'string')
      && (evidence.gitIdentity === undefined || identity(evidence.gitIdentity))
  }
  const validOperation = value.operation === 'apply'
    || value.operation === 'preview'
    || value.operation === 'checkpoint'
    || value.operation === 'rollback_preview'
    || value.operation === 'finish'
    || value.operation === 'finalize_preview'
    || value.operation === 'cleanup'
  const validStep = value.step === 'planning'
    || value.step === 'artifacts_retained'
    || value.step === 'committing_session_branch'
    || value.step === 'writing_local'
    || value.step === 'updating_ref'
    || value.step === 'replacing_index'
    || value.step === 'removing_worktree'
  return validOperation
    && validStep
    && (value.baseOid === undefined || typeof value.baseOid === 'string')
    && (value.planRevision === undefined || typeof value.planRevision === 'string')
    && (value.previewId === undefined || typeof value.previewId === 'string')
    && (value.reviewId === undefined || typeof value.reviewId === 'string')
    && (value.localFingerprint === undefined || typeof value.localFingerprint === 'string')
    && (value.isolatedFingerprint === undefined || typeof value.isolatedFingerprint === 'string')
    && (value.effectiveBaseOid === undefined || typeof value.effectiveBaseOid === 'string')
    && (value.baseStrategy === undefined || value.baseStrategy === 'recorded_base' || value.baseStrategy === 'isolated_contains_local_head' || value.baseStrategy === 'local_contains_isolated_head')
    && (value.localHeadOid === undefined || typeof value.localHeadOid === 'string')
    && (value.isolatedHeadOid === undefined || typeof value.isolatedHeadOid === 'string')
    && (value.commitOid === undefined || isOid(value.commitOid))
    && (value.checkpointId === undefined || isBoundedText(value.checkpointId, 200))
    && (value.checkpointSequence === undefined || (Number.isSafeInteger(value.checkpointSequence) && (value.checkpointSequence as number) >= 1))
    && (value.checkpointRequestId === undefined || (isBoundedText(value.checkpointRequestId, 200) && !/[\r\n]/u.test(value.checkpointRequestId)))
    && (value.checkpointRequestedRevision === undefined || (Number.isSafeInteger(value.checkpointRequestedRevision) && (value.checkpointRequestedRevision as number) >= 0))
    && (value.checkpointMessage === undefined || isValidCommitMessage(value.checkpointMessage))
    && (value.checkpointIndexTreeOid === undefined || isOid(value.checkpointIndexTreeOid))
    && (value.parentOid === undefined || isOid(value.parentOid))
    && (value.retention === undefined || value.retention === 'cleanup' || value.retention === 'retain_24h' || value.retention === 'retain_3d' || value.retention === 'retain_manual')
    && (value.recoveryGeneration === undefined || (typeof value.recoveryGeneration === 'string' && /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/u.test(value.recoveryGeneration)))
    && (value.resumeRevision === undefined || typeof value.resumeRevision === 'boolean')

}

function migrateLegacyRegistry(value: unknown): ManagedCheckoutsRegistry | null {
  if (
    !isRecord(value)
    || value.version !== 1
    || typeof value.revision !== 'number'
    || !isRecord(value.sessionBindings)
    || !isRecord(value.managedCheckouts)
    || !Object.values(value.sessionBindings).every(isSessionBinding)
  ) return null
  const managedCheckouts: ManagedCheckoutsRegistry['managedCheckouts'] = {}
  for (const [checkoutId, raw] of Object.entries(value.managedCheckouts)) {
    if (
      !isRecord(raw)
      || typeof raw.checkoutId !== 'string'
      || typeof raw.projectId !== 'string'
      || typeof raw.projectName !== 'string'
      || typeof raw.ownerSessionId !== 'string'
      || typeof raw.localRoot !== 'string'
      || typeof raw.managedRoot !== 'string'
      || typeof raw.managedGitRoot !== 'string'
      || typeof raw.gitCommonDir !== 'string'
      || typeof raw.gitDir !== 'string'
      || typeof raw.baseOid !== 'string'
      || typeof raw.sourceRef !== 'string'
      || typeof raw.revision !== 'number'
    ) return null
    const legacyPhase = raw.phase
    const phase = legacyPhase === 'ready' || legacyPhase === 'discarded'
      ? legacyPhase
      : 'recovery_required'
    managedCheckouts[checkoutId] = {
      checkoutId: raw.checkoutId,
      projectId: raw.projectId,
      projectName: raw.projectName,
      ownerSessionId: raw.ownerSessionId,
      localRoot: raw.localRoot,
      managedRoot: raw.managedRoot,
      managedGitRoot: raw.managedGitRoot,
      gitCommonDir: raw.gitCommonDir,
      gitDir: raw.gitDir,
      baseOid: raw.baseOid,
      ...(typeof raw.applyBaseOid === 'string' ? { applyBaseOid: raw.applyBaseOid } : {}),
      sourceRef: raw.sourceRef,
      phase,
      delivery: { state: 'working', iteration: 1 },
      journal: null,
      revision: raw.revision + (phase === legacyPhase ? 0 : 1),
    }
  }
  return {
    version: 2,
    revision: value.revision + 1,
    sessionBindings: value.sessionBindings as ManagedCheckoutsRegistry['sessionBindings'],
    managedCheckouts,
  }
}

  const delivery = record.delivery
  if (delivery.state !== 'ready_for_review' && delivery.state !== 'preview_active') return undefined
  return createHash('sha256').update(canonicalJson({

    isolatedHeadOid: delivery.review.isolatedHeadOid,

function validRequest(request: unknown): request is WorktreeRecoveryRequest {
  if (typeof request !== 'object' || request === null) return false
  const value = request as Record<string, unknown>
  const common = typeof value.sessionId === 'string'
    && value.sessionId.length > 0 && value.sessionId.length <= 200 && !/[\0\r\n]/u.test(value.sessionId)
    && typeof value.requestId === 'string'
    && value.requestId.length > 0 && value.requestId.length <= 500 && !/[\0\r\n]/u.test(value.requestId)
    && typeof value.checkoutId === 'string'
    && value.checkoutId.length > 0 && value.checkoutId.length <= 200
    && !value.checkoutId.includes('..') && !/[\\/\0\r\n]/u.test(value.checkoutId)
    && typeof value.reviewId === 'string'
    && value.reviewId.length > 0 && value.reviewId.length <= 200 && !/[\0\r\n]/u.test(value.reviewId)
    && Number.isSafeInteger(value.revision) && (value.revision as number) >= 0
  if (!common) return false
  switch (value.kind) {
    case 'worktree_review_regeneration':
      return hasExactKeys(value, ['kind', 'sessionId', 'requestId', 'checkoutId', 'reviewId', 'revision'])
    case 'worktree_apply_conflict':
      return hasExactKeys(value, ['kind', 'sessionId', 'requestId', 'checkoutId', 'reviewId', 'revision', 'localHeadOid', 'conflictingFiles'])
        && typeof value.localHeadOid === 'string'
        && /^(?:[0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})$/iu.test(value.localHeadOid)
        && Array.isArray(value.conflictingFiles)
        && value.conflictingFiles.length <= 500
        && value.conflictingFiles.every(file => typeof file === 'string' && safeConflictFile(file))
    default:
      return false
  }
}

function targetMatchesRequest(target: WorktreeConsoleTargetDetails, request: WorktreeRecoveryRequest): boolean {
  if (
    target.checkoutId !== request.checkoutId
    || target.ownerSessionId !== request.sessionId
    || target.targetSessionId !== request.sessionId
    || target.revision !== request.revision
    || target.managedRoot === null
  ) return false
  if (request.kind === 'worktree_apply_conflict') {
    const proof = target.recoveryContinuation
    return target.state === 'working'
      && target.review === undefined
      && proof?.kind === request.kind
      && proof.requestId === request.requestId
      && proof.checkoutId === request.checkoutId
      && proof.reviewId === request.reviewId
      && proof.revision === request.revision
      && proof.localHeadOid === request.localHeadOid
      && proof.conflictingFiles.length === request.conflictingFiles.length
      && proof.conflictingFiles.every((file, index) => file === request.conflictingFiles[index])
  }
  const proof = target.recoveryContinuation
  return target.state === 'ready_for_review'
    && target.review?.reviewId === request.reviewId
    && target.capabilities.preflight
    && proof?.kind === request.kind
    && proof.requestId === request.requestId
    && proof.checkoutId === request.checkoutId
    && proof.reviewId === request.reviewId
    && proof.revision === request.revision
}

function capabilities(
  record: ManagedCheckoutRecord,
  callerSessionId: string,
  ownerSessionAvailable = true,
  linkedRead = false,
): WorktreeConsoleCapabilities {
  const owner = callerSessionId === record.ownerSessionId
  const source = callerSessionId === record.sourceSessionId
  const sourceReservation = source && !ownerSessionAvailable
  const readAuthorized = owner || source || linkedRead
  const ready = record.phase === 'ready' && record.delivery.state === 'ready_for_review'
  const previewActive = record.phase === 'ready' && record.delivery.state === 'preview_active'
  const previewDetached = record.phase === 'ready' && record.delivery.state === 'preview_detached'
  const previewRecovery = record.phase === 'recovery_required'
    && record.delivery.state === 'preview_active'
    && record.journal?.operation === 'rollback_preview'
  const cleanup = record.delivery.state === 'finalized' || record.delivery.state === 'retained'
  const delivered = record.phase === 'discarded' && record.delivery.state === 'delivered'
  const active = record.phase !== 'discarded'
  return {
    create: false,
    open: readAuthorized && active && (!linkedRead || ownerSessionAvailable),
    inspect: readAuthorized,
    discard: (owner || sourceReservation) && active && !cleanup && !previewDetached,
    preflight: owner && ready,
    preview: owner && ready,
    checkpoint: owner && (ready || previewActive),
    resumeRevision: owner && ready,
    rollbackPreview: owner && (previewActive || previewDetached || previewRecovery),
    finalize: owner && ready,
    finalizePreview: owner && (previewActive || previewDetached),
    // Retention/permanence/cleanup act on the frozen directory itself, so the Host gates
    // them to the owner Session only — never offer them to the Local source Session.
    setRetention: owner && record.delivery.state === 'retained',
    setPermanent: owner && active,
    retryCleanup: owner && cleanup,
    beginNextIteration: owner && delivered,
    // Only the owner Session can be rebound, and only once the Worktree has
    // actually reached delivery: releasing an in-flight Worktree would strand
    // its review/preview state with no Session pointing at it. The host keeps
    // the call idempotent, so a Session already standing on Local simply gets
    // the Local projection back.
    returnToLocal: owner && worktreeReachedDelivery(record.phase, record.delivery.state),
  }
}

function sanitizeManagedWorktreeLabel(rawName: string | undefined): string {
  let cleaned = (rawName ?? '')
    .trim()
    .normalize('NFC')
    .replace(WINDOWS_INVALID_CHARACTERS, '-')
    .replace(/\s+/g, '-')
    .replace(REPEATED_DASHES, '-')
    .replace(/^[.\s-]+|[.\s-]+$/g, '')

  cleaned = truncateCodePoints(cleaned, MAX_LABEL_LENGTH)
    .replace(/[.\s-]+$/g, '')

  if (!cleaned) return 'repository'
  return WINDOWS_RESERVED_NAME.test(cleaned) ? `_${cleaned}` : cleaned
}

interface SessionCheckoutGitPort {
  /** Optional for third-party ports; unsupported ports must not initialize. */
  preflightInitialCommit?(root: string): Promise<InitialCommitPreflight>
  initializeEmptyRepository?(root: string, fingerprint: string, assertAuthorized?: () => Promise<void>): Promise<string>
  /** Local adaptation: turn a non-Git or unborn project into a committed repository on explicit user confirmation. */
  initializeProject?(root: string): Promise<void>
  /** Short names of local branches, sorted, for the create-time base picker. */
  listLocalBranches?(root: string): Promise<string[]>
  /** Tip commit of a local branch, or null when the ref does not resolve. */
  resolveLocalBranchTip?(root: string, branch: string): Promise<string | null>
  inspect(root: string): Promise<GitCheckoutSnapshot | null>
  /** Top-level of the Git checkout containing the directory; does not require a HEAD. */
  findContainingWorktreeRoot(root: string): Promise<string | null>
  status(root: string): Promise<{ dirty: boolean }>
  createDetachedWorktree(localRoot: string, managedRoot: string, baseOid: string, saveEvidence?: (evidence: WorktreeCreationEvidence) => void): Promise<void>
  /**
   * Local adaptation: point a freshly created managed Worktree's HEAD at a real
   * session-owned branch without touching a single file. `expectedOldOid` null
   * creates the branch only when the ref does not exist yet; otherwise the ref
   * moves only from that exact old OID, so a concurrent session never loses
   * commits. Ports without it keep the legacy detached-HEAD behaviour.
   */
  attachWorktreeBranch?(managedRoot: string, branchRef: string, headOid: string, expectedOldOid: string | null): Promise<void>
  /** Deletion after the host verified checkout identity and the full fingerprint including untracked. */
  removeWorktree(localRoot: string, managedRoot: string): Promise<void>
  retainApplyBase(localRoot: string, checkoutId: string, oid: string): Promise<void>
  releaseApplyBase(localRoot: string, checkoutId: string): Promise<void>
  retainInternalArtifact(localRoot: string, checkoutId: string, artifactName: string, oid: string): Promise<void>
  /** Read one retained internal ref without modifying refs or object storage. */
  readInternalArtifact(localRoot: string, checkoutId: string, artifactName: string): Promise<string | null>
  releaseInternalArtifacts(localRoot: string, checkoutId: string, artifactPrefix?: string): Promise<void>
  /** Read-only ancestry proof; only accepts host-verified checkout roots and OIDs. */
  isAncestor(root: string, ancestorOid: string, descendantOid: string): Promise<boolean>
  listWorktreeincludeFiles?(localRoot: string, includeFile: string): Promise<string[]>
  /**
   * Local adaptation: best-effort `git push` of the given worktree's current
   * branch. Never force-pushes; never rewrites remote history. Returns the
   * human-readable failure instead of throwing so callers can degrade softly.
   */
  pushBranch?(root: string): Promise<{ ok: boolean; message?: string }>
  /**
   * Local adaptation: re-link Worktrees whose `.git` pointer broke because the
   * repository moved, via `git worktree repair`. Returns false instead of
   * throwing so callers can leave the stale record untouched.
   */
  repairWorktreeLinks?(repoCommonDir: string, managedRoot: string): Promise<boolean>
  /**
   * Local adaptation: drop Worktree admin entries whose working tree vanished
   * from disk (`git worktree prune`). Hygiene only; callers tolerate absence.
   */
  pruneWorktrees?(localRoot: string): Promise<void>
  /**
   * Local adaptation: branch overview for the header chip popover — every
   * local branch with its tip, upstream, and the checkout marker, plus the
   * dirty entry count (`-1` when the status read overflowed and the count is
   * unknown). Two parallel spawns per refresh; null on git failure.
   */
  branchOverview?(root: string): Promise<{ branches: BranchOverviewEntry[]; dirtyCount: number } | null>
  /**
   * Local adaptation: the repository's trunk branch name (`origin/HEAD`, then
   * `init.defaultBranch`); null when neither resolves. Never guesses 'main'.
   */
  defaultBranch?(root: string): Promise<string | null>
  /**
   * Local adaptation: tip committer time (ms) per local branch name, one spawn.
   * Powers the stale-branch age filter; ports without it disable age filtering.
   */
  branchTipTimes?(root: string): Promise<Record<string, number>>
  /**
   * Local adaptation: creation time (ms) per local branch name, parsed in one
   * spawn from every branch reflog's `branch: Created from` entries. Powers
   * the concurrent branch-race guard; ports without it leave the guard silent.
   */
  branchCreationTimes?(root: string): Promise<Record<string, number> | undefined>
  /** Local adaptation: safely delete a fully merged local branch (`git branch -d`); never force. */
  deleteLocalBranch?(root: string, name: string): Promise<{ deleted: boolean; reason?: string }>
  /**
   * Local adaptation: merge a session-owned worktree branch into the local checkout HEAD.
   * dryRun probes in a throwaway detached worktree and never touches the checkout;
   * a real merge leaves conflict state in place (never aborts) so the caller can resolve.
   */
  mergeLocalBranch?(root: string, source: string, options?: { dryRun?: boolean }): Promise<MergeLocalBranchResult>
  /** Local adaptation: one read-only page of the commit graph (topo-order, all refs). */
  graphLog?(root: string, limit: number): Promise<GraphLogCommit[]>
  /** Local adaptation: create a local branch at HEAD after `git check-ref-format`. */
  createLocalBranch?(root: string, name: string): Promise<void>
  /** Local adaptation: switch the local checkout to an existing local branch. */
  switchLocalBranch?(root: string, branch: string): Promise<void>
  /**
   * Local adaptation: local tags with their commit, annotation state and
   * whether `origin` already carries the same name. One spawn for tags, one
   * best-effort spawn for the remote check; null when git fails.
   */
  listTags?(root: string): Promise<TagOverviewEntry[] | null>
  /** Local adaptation: create a lightweight or annotated tag after `git check-ref-format`. */
  createTag?(root: string, name: string, options?: { message?: string; target?: string }): Promise<void>
  /** Local adaptation: delete a local tag (`git tag -d`); never touches the remote. */
  deleteLocalTag?(root: string, name: string): Promise<void>
  /**
   * Local adaptation: push a single tag to `origin` without force. Returns the
   * human-readable failure instead of throwing so callers can degrade softly.
   */
  pushTag?(root: string, name: string): Promise<{ ok: boolean; message?: string }>
  /** Local adaptation: delete a tag on `origin` (never forced). */
  deleteRemoteTag?(root: string, name: string): Promise<{ ok: boolean; message?: string }>
  /**
   * Local adaptation (codex parity): capture the checkout's uncommitted tracked
   * changes as a binary patch against HEAD, or null when the worktree is clean.
   */
  captureLocalWip?(root: string): Promise<string | null>
  /** Local adaptation (codex parity): apply a captured WIP patch inside a freshly created worktree. */
  applyWorktreePatch?(root: string, patch: string): Promise<void>
  /** Local adaptation (codex parity): non-ignored untracked paths, relative to root. */
  listUntrackedFiles?(root: string): Promise<string[]>
  /**
   * codex 对齐：删除带未提交内容的受管 Worktree 前，把全部可丢失内容

  restoreAbandonedSnapshot?(localRoot: string, checkoutId: string, snapshotOid: string): Promise<string>
}

# worktreeWorkspaceProvider 服务，cordis strict get 要求提供者 fiber 已 ACTIVE——
# host 侧插件 apply 期间自己还是 LOADING（选举恒败 → decorate 回退），renderer
